Boosting Repeat Rates by Adding Gamification to Loyalty Programs—3 Mechanisms E-commerce Operators Can Implement Immediately

There is renewed attention on loyalty programs in the e-commerce industry. Simply awarding points is often insufficient to change customer behavior; designing a 'visible progress and instant reward' experience, similar to a game, can significantly improve repeat rates.
According to research by Open Loyalty (Source: https://openloyalty.io/ ), an analysis of over 170 industry experts revealed that 81% of consumers are interested in visual progress bars.
The global loyalty management market is projected to grow at an annual rate of 15% to reach $32.5 billion by 2031, and by starting now, you can get ahead of your competitors.
Mechanism 1: Visualize 'Almost There' with a Progress Bar
Place a progress gauge on your 'My Page' or purchase completion screen that says, 'X points (or Y yen) until your next reward.'
The key is for it to update in real-time with every purchase. Providing specific numbers, such as 'Spend 500 yen more to earn 1,000 points,' increases the effectiveness of the call to action.
